subject.title: fix(talk): reject malformed relay audio base64

question: Which previously tolerated base64 variants must `talk.session.appendAudio` continue accepting while malformed relay audio is rejected?
rationale: The public protocol currently says only “base64 PCM,” while the patch replaces permissive Node decoding with a stricter canonicalization contract; code inspection cannot determine whether unpadded, whitespace-bearing, or base64url input is an intentional compatibility surface.

options.title: Preserve benign variants
options.body: Accept and test explicitly supported noncanonical forms while rejecting characters or encodings that cannot round-trip to the same audio bytes.

options.title: Require canonical base64
options.body: Define standard canonical base64 as the public wire contract, document the stricter behavior, and accept the upgrade impact for other clients.

recommendation.title: Preserve benign variants
recommendation.body: Accept and test explicitly supported noncanonical forms while rejecting characters or encodings that cannot round-trip to the same audio bytes.

likelyOwner.reason: VACInc is the strongest available server-side Talk/Gateway owner-routing signal for deciding the relay wire contract.
